Erdogan Raises Kashmir at UNGA; Trump Warns Iran

Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan raised the issue of Kashmir at the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), calling for the dispute to be resolved under the UN Charter. Separately, U.S. President Donald Trump issued a strong warning to Iran at the UNGA, stating that Iran would never be allowed to develop a nuclear bomb. Following Trump's remarks, Cuban representatives walked out of the UNGA hall.
